@@ -2,6 +2,26 @@
 
 All notable changes to `omp-spec-kit`. Claims are limited to recorded evidence.
 
+## 2.9.0 — 2026-10-09
+
+### Added
+
+- Claude Code plugin support: the same `plugins/omp-spec-kit` payload installs in Claude Code 2.1.292 or newer, and a `PreToolUse` hook enforces the `.specs` boundary by blocking reads and writes of `.specs`. The hook is a barrier, not a sandbox; Bash-level checks are regex based.
+
+### Changed
+
+- Single marketplace catalog moved to `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`; OMP reads it by fallback, and the separate `.omp-plugin/marketplace.json` is removed.
+- The MCP server is launched with `node` and the plugin-root placeholder pointing at `dist/mcp/server.js`; the `sh` launcher under `bin/` is removed from the payload.
+- Protocol version negotiation is limited to the supported versions.
+- The `spec-inventory` skill now uses `spec_catalog` with `view: "inventory"`, and the `/spec-inventory` command is removed.
+- Maintainer-only skills `release-operator` and `tool-e2e` moved out of the shipped payload to repository-level `.claude/skills/`.
+- The `spec-elicitation` skill no longer names OMP-only tools and works with any host question tool, or plain text when the host has none.
+
+### Fixed
+
+- The server no longer exits when `OMP_SPEC_KIT_PACKAGE_ROOT` equals the working directory.
+- The plugin version is reported correctly.
+
 ## 2.6.2 — 2026-09-22

+### Claude Code
+
+Requires Claude Code 2.1.292 or newer. In a Claude Code session:
+
+```text
+/plugin marketplace add stgmt/omp-spec-kit
+/plugin install omp-spec-kit@omp-spec-kit
+/reload-plugins
+```
+

+// \c\x on the current drive, outside the project, and the check would pass.
+const MSYS_DRIVE_PATH = /^\/(?:cygdrive\/)?([a-zA-Z])(?:\/([\s\S]*))?$/u;
+const DRIVE_PREFIX = /^[a-zA-Z]:/u;
+const URI_PREFIX = /^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9+.-]*:\/\//u;

+  return value !== null && typeof value === "object" && !Array.isArray(value);

+  return typeof value === "string" && value.trim() !== "";
+}
+

+  if (platform !== "win32" || typeof value !== "string") return value;
+  const match = MSYS_DRIVE_PATH.exec(value);
+  return match === null ? value : `${match[1].toUpperCase()}:/${match[2] ?? ""}`;
+}

+// Claude Code resolves a relative tool path against the session cwd, but the
+// classifier resolves it against the project root. Make plain relative paths
+// absolute here so a subfolder session cannot reach ../.specs unseen. Anything
+// the classifier treats specially (URIs, drive-relative or colon-bearing paths
+// on win32, NUL bytes) is left untouched so its own unsafe-path rules still fire.
+function absolutize(value, base, platform) {
+  if (!nonEmptyString(value) || value.includes("\u0000")) return value;
+  if (path.isAbsolute(value) || DRIVE_PREFIX.test(value) || URI_PREFIX.test(value)) return value;
+  if (platform === "win32" && value.includes(":")) return value;
+  return path.resolve(base, value);

+  const value = toolInput[key];
+  if (value === undefined) return undefined;

+++ b/plugins/omp-spec-kit/hooks/pretooluse.mjs
@@ -0,0 +1,55 @@
+import { writeSync } from "node:fs";
+import { toClassifierEvent } from "./normalize.mjs";
+
+// Claude Code PreToolUse hook: exit 0 with no output allows the call, exit 2
+// with the reason on stderr blocks it. Nothing is ever written to stdout, and
+// every failure path blocks (fail closed).
+const MAX_STDIN_BYTES = 1024 * 1024;
+const CLASSIFIER_URL = new URL("../dist/enforcement/classifier.js", import.meta.url).href;
+
+function writeStderr(text) {
+  try {
+    writeSync(2, text);
+  } catch {
+    process.stderr.write(text);
+  }
+}
+
+function block(reason) {
+  writeStderr(`${reason}\n`);
+  process.exitCode = 2;
+}
+
+async function readStdin() {
+  const chunks = [];
+  let size = 0;
+  for await (const chunk of process.stdin) {
+    size += chunk.length;
+    if (size > MAX_STDIN_BYTES) throw new RangeError(`stdin exceeds ${MAX_STDIN_BYTES} bytes`);
+    chunks.push(chunk);
+  }
+  const text = Buffer.concat(chunks).toString("utf8");
+  return text.charCodeAt(0) === 0xfeff ? text.slice(1) : text;
+}
+
+async function main() {
+  const text = await readStdin();
+  if (text.trim() === "") throw new Error("empty hook input");
+  const hookInput = JSON.parse(text);
+  const { event, root } = toClassifierEvent(hookInput);
+  const { classifyToolCall } = await import(CLASSIFIER_URL);
+  const decision = classifyToolCall(event, { root });
+  if (decision?.action === "block") {
+    block(typeof decision.reason === "string" && decision.reason !== "" ? decision.reason : `SPEC_HOOK_BLOCKED: ${decision.code ?? "blocked"}`);
+    return;
+  }
+  if (decision?.action !== "allow" && decision?.action !== "continue") {
+    throw new Error("classifier returned no decision");
+  }
+}
+
+try {
+  await main();
+} catch (error) {
+  block(`SPEC_HOOK_FAILED: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`);
+}

+import assert from "node:assert/strict";
+import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process";

+import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
+import path from "node:path";
+import { after, before, describe, it } from "node:test";
+import { fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL } from "node:url";
+
+// Spawns the real Claude Code PreToolUse hook (plugins/omp-spec-kit/hooks/pretooluse.mjs)
+// with a Claude Code style stdin payload. It loads dist/enforcement/classifier.js,
+// so the plugin must be built (npm run build) before this runs.
+const repositoryRoot = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "..", "..");
+const hookPath = path.join(repositoryRoot, "plugins", "omp-spec-kit", "hooks", "pretooluse.mjs");
+const normalizeUrl = pathToFileURL(path.join(repositoryRoot, "plugins", "omp-spec-kit", "hooks", "normalize.mjs")).href;
+const { toClassifierEvent } = await import(normalizeUrl);
+
+const OWN_MCP = "mcp__plugin_omp-spec-kit_omp-spec-kit__";
+const SCENARIO_FEATURE = "Feature: Foo\n  Scenario: Foo works\n    Given a foo\n";
+
+let projectDir;
+let specFile;
+let subDir;
+
+before(() => {
+  projectDir = realpathSync.native(mkdtempSync(path.join(tmpdir(), "omp-spec-kit-hook-")));
+  mkdirSync(path.join(projectDir, ".specs", "foo"), { recursive: true });
+  specFile = path.join(projectDir, ".specs", "foo", "foo.md");
+  writeFileSync(specFile, "# Foo\n");
+  writeFileSync(path.join(projectDir, ".specs", "foo", "foo.feature"), SCENARIO_FEATURE);
+  writeFileSync(path.join(projectDir, "README.md"), "# Project\n");
+  subDir = path.join(projectDir, "sub");
+  mkdirSync(subDir);
+});
+
+after(() => {
+  rmSync(projectDir, { recursive: true, force: true });
+});
+
+function payload(toolName, toolInput, cwd = projectDir) {
+  return {
+    session_id: "test-session",
+    transcript_path: path.join(projectDir, "transcript.jsonl"),
+    cwd,
+    permission_mode: "default",
+    hook_event_name: "PreToolUse",
+    tool_name: toolName,
+    tool_input: toolInput,
+    tool_use_id: "toolu_test",
+  };
+}
+
+function runHook(stdin, { cwd = projectDir, env = {} } = {}) {
+  const result = spawnSync(process.execPath, [hookPath], {
+    input: typeof stdin === "string" ? stdin : JSON.stringify(stdin),
+    cwd,

+    env: { ...process.env, CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR: projectDir, ...env },

+  });

+import assert from "node:assert/strict";
+import { spawn } from "node:child_process";
+import { mkdirSync, mkdtempSync, readFileSync, realpathSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
+import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
+import path from "node:path";
+import { after, before, describe, it } from "node:test";
+import { fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL } from "node:url";
+
+// Launches the server exactly as Claude Code does from plugins/omp-spec-kit/.mcp.json
+// (command node, no shell, no launcher script), with the host placeholders substituted.
+// It runs the built dist/mcp/server.js, so the plugin must be built first.
+const repositoryRoot = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "..", "..");
+const pluginRoot = path.join(repositoryRoot, "plugins", "omp-spec-kit");
+const PLUGIN_ROOT_PLACEHOLDER = "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}";
+const PROJECT_DIR_PLACEHOLDER = "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}";
+const EXPECTED_TOOL_COUNT = 10;
+const STEP_TIMEOUT_MS = 20_000;
+
+let projectDir;
+let otherCwd;
+
+before(() => {
+  projectDir = realpathSync.native(mkdtempSync(path.join(tmpdir(), "omp-spec-kit-mcp-project-")));
+  mkdirSync(path.join(projectDir, ".specs", "foo"), { recursive: true });
+  writeFileSync(path.join(projectDir, ".specs", "foo", "foo.md"), "# Foo\n");
+  otherCwd = realpathSync.native(mkdtempSync(path.join(tmpdir(), "omp-spec-kit-mcp-cwd-")));
+});
+
+after(() => {
+  rmSync(projectDir, { recursive: true, force: true });
+  rmSync(otherCwd, { recursive: true, force: true });
+});
+
+function readServerConfig() {
+  const config = JSON.parse(readFileSync(path.join(pluginRoot, ".mcp.json"), "utf8"));
+  return config.mcpServers["omp-spec-kit"];
+}
+
+function substitute(value) {
+  const pluginRootPosix = pluginRoot.split(path.sep).join("/");
+  return value
+    .replaceAll(PLUGIN_ROOT_PLACEHOLDER, () => pluginRootPosix)
+    .replaceAll(PROJECT_DIR_PLACEHOLDER, () => projectDir);
+}
+
+function baseEnvironment() {
+  const env = {};
+  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(process.env)) {
+    if (!key.startsWith("OMP_SPEC_KIT_")) env[key] = value;
+  }
+  return env;
+}
+
+// Newline-delimited JSON-RPC session: send three messages, wait for the tools/list reply,
+// close stdin, and resolve with everything the server wrote.
+function runSession(server) {
+  const args = server.args.map(substitute);
+  const env = { ...baseEnvironment(), ...Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(server.env ?? {}).map(([key, value]) => [key, substitute(value)])) };
+  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+    const child = spawn(server.command, args, { cwd: otherCwd, env, shell: false, stdio: ["pipe", "pipe", "pipe"], windowsHide: true });
+    let stdout = "";
+    let stderr = "";
+    let settled = false;
+    let listed = false;
+    const timer = setTimeout(() => finish(new Error(`MCP session timed out; stdout=${stdout.slice(0, 500)} stderr=${stderr.slice(0, 500)}`)), STEP_TIMEOUT_MS);
+
+    function finish(error) {
+      if (settled) return;
+      settled = true;
+      clearTimeout(timer);
+      if (error) {
+        child.kill();
+        reject(error);
+      }
+    }
+
+    child.on("error", finish);
+    child.stderr.setEncoding("utf8");
+    child.stderr.on("data", (chunk) => {
+      stderr += chunk;
+    });
+    child.stdout.setEncoding("utf8");
+    child.stdout.on("data", (chunk) => {
+      stdout += chunk;
+      if (!listed && stdout.split("\n").some((line) => line.includes('"id":2'))) {
+        listed = true;
+        child.stdin.end();
+      }
+    });
+    child.on("close", (code) => {
+      if (settled) return;
+      settled = true;
+      clearTimeout(timer);
+      resolve({ code, stdout, stderr });
+    });
+
+    const send = (message) => child.stdin.write(`${JSON.stringify(message)}\n`);
+    send({
+      jsonrpc: "2.0",
+      id: 1,
+      method: "initialize",
+      params: { protocolVersion: "2025-11-25", capabilities: {}, clientInfo: { name: "omp-spec-kit-launch-test", version: "0.0.0" } },
+    });
+    send({ jsonrpc: "2.0", method: "notifications/initialized" });
+    send({ jsonrpc: "2.0", id: 2, method: "tools/list" });
+  });
+}
+
+describe(".mcp.json launch shape", () => {
+  it("is a node command over dist/mcp/server.js with the project root passed in env", () => {
+    const server = readServerConfig();
+    assert.equal(server.type, "stdio");
+    assert.equal(server.command, "node");
+    assert.deepEqual(server.args, [`${PLUGIN_ROOT_PLACEHOLDER}/dist/mcp/server.js`]);
+    assert.deepEqual(server.env, { OMP_SPEC_KIT_ROOT: PROJECT_DIR_PLACEHOLDER });
+  });
+});
+
+describe("Claude Code MCP launch", () => {
+  it("starts from .mcp.json args, answers tools/list with ten tools and keeps stdout JSON-only", async () => {
+    const { code, stdout, stderr } = await runSession(readServerConfig());
+    assert.equal(stderr, "");
+    assert.equal(code, 0);
+
+    const lines = stdout.split("\n").filter((line) => line.trim() !== "");
+    assert.ok(lines.length >= 2, `expected initialize and tools/list replies, got ${lines.length} line(s)`);
+    const messages = lines.map((line) => {
+      try {
+        return JSON.parse(line);
+      } catch {
+        assert.fail(`stdout line is not JSON: ${line.slice(0, 200)}`);
+      }
+    });
+    for (const message of messages) assert.equal(message.jsonrpc, "2.0");
+
+    const initialized = messages.find((message) => message.id === 1);
+    assert.equal(initialized?.result?.serverInfo?.name, "omp-spec-kit");
+    const listed = messages.find((message) => message.id === 2);
+    assert.equal(listed?.error, undefined);
+    assert.equal(listed?.result?.tools?.length, EXPECTED_TOOL_COUNT);
+    assert.equal(new Set(listed.result.tools.map((tool) => tool.name)).size, EXPECTED_TOOL_COUNT);
+  });
+});
+
+describe("OMP_SPEC_KIT_ROOT placeholder handling", () => {
+  const modulePath = path.join(pluginRoot, "dist", "adapters", "query-service.js");
+
+  it("honors the substituted project directory as the repository root", async () => {
+    const { resolveRepositoryContext } = await import(pathToFileURL(modulePath).href);
+    const context = resolveRepositoryContext({ OMP_SPEC_KIT_ROOT: projectDir }, otherCwd);
+    assert.equal(context.resolvedRoot, projectDir);
+    assert.equal(context.rootMode, "explicit-absolute-override");
+  });
+
+  it("ignores an unsubstituted placeholder (a host that does not expand it) and falls back to cwd", async () => {
+    const { resolveRepositoryContext } = await import(pathToFileURL(modulePath).href);
+    const context = resolveRepositoryContext({ OMP_SPEC_KIT_ROOT: PROJECT_DIR_PLACEHOLDER }, projectDir);
+    assert.equal(context.resolvedRoot, projectDir);
+    assert.equal(context.rootMode, "active-project");
+  });
+});

+
+// Drives the release evaluator over a real candidate world and checks the
+// evidence identity gate: the schema, the exact top-level key set, and the
+// tag/commit identity that every evidence file must carry.
+const repositoryRoot = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "..", "..");
+const IDENTITY_BLOCKER = "evidence-identity-mismatch";
+const { version } = JSON.parse(readFileSync(path.join(repositoryRoot, "plugins", "omp-spec-kit", "package.json"), "utf8"));
+let tempRoot;
+let world;
+let original;
+
+before(async () => {
+  tempRoot = realpathSync.native(mkdtempSync(path.join(tmpdir(), "omp-spec-kit-evidence-")));
+  world = await createCandidateWorld(repositoryRoot, tempRoot, await readVerifiedCucumberFixture(repositoryRoot), `v${version}`);
+  original = readFileSync(world.evidencePath, "utf8");
+});
+
+after(() => {
+  rmSync(tempRoot, { recursive: true, force: true });
+});
+
+async function evaluateWithEvidence(mutate) {
+  const evidence = JSON.parse(original);
+  mutate(evidence);
+  writeFileSync(world.evidencePath, `${JSON.stringify(evidence, null, 2)}\n`);
+  try {
+    return await evaluateCandidate(world, repositoryRoot);
+  } finally {
+    writeFileSync(world.evidencePath, original);
+  }

+import assert from "node:assert/strict";
+import { spawn } from "node:child_process";
+import { mkdtempSync, readFileSync, realpathSync, rmSync } from "node:fs";
+import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
+import path from "node:path";
+import { describe, it } from "node:test";

+// modes shipped incorrectly before: placeholder substitution, candidate file
+// modes, the release manager tool count, version identity across the built
+// payload, the MCP preflight versions, and the bounded connect retry.
+const repositoryRoot = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "..", "..");

+function preflightVersions(serverPath) {
+  const cwd = realpathSync.native(mkdtempSync(path.join(tmpdir(), "omp-spec-kit-preflight-")));
+  const env = { ...process.env };
+  delete env.OMP_SPEC_KIT_ROOT;
+  delete env.OMP_SPEC_KIT_PACKAGE_ROOT;
+  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+    const child = spawn(process.execPath, [serverPath], { cwd, env, stdio: ["pipe", "pipe", "pipe"], windowsHide: true });
+    let buffered = "";
+    const timer = setTimeout(() => finish(new Error("mcp_preflight timed out")), 20_000);
+    function finish(error, value) {
+      clearTimeout(timer);
+      child.kill();
+      child.once("exit", () => rmSync(cwd, { recursive: true, force: true, maxRetries: 3 }));
+      if (error) reject(error);
+      else resolve(value);
+    }
+    child.stdout.setEncoding("utf8");
+    child.stdout.on("data", (chunk) => {
+      buffered += chunk;
+      let newline = buffered.indexOf("\n");
+      while (newline !== -1) {
+        const line = buffered.slice(0, newline);
+        buffered = buffered.slice(newline + 1);
+        newline = buffered.indexOf("\n");
+        if (line.trim() === "") continue;
+        const message = JSON.parse(line);
+        if (message.id === 1) {
+          child.stdin.write(`${JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: "2.0", method: "notifications/initialized" })}\n`);
+          child.stdin.write(`${JSON.stringify({
+            jsonrpc: "2.0",
+            id: 2,
+            method: "tools/call",
+            params: { name: "mcp_preflight", arguments: { schemaVersion: "spec-kernel@2", requestId: "tooling-preflight" } },
+          })}\n`);
+        } else if (message.id === 2) {
+          finish(null, message.result.structuredContent.data.versions);
+        }
+      }
+    });
+    child.on("error", (error) => finish(error));
+    child.stdin.write(`${JSON.stringify({
+      jsonrpc: "2.0",
+      id: 1,
+      method: "initialize",
+      params: { protocolVersion: "2025-11-25", capabilities: {}, clientInfo: { name: "tooling-test", version: "1" } },
+    })}\n`);
+  });
+}
+
+describe("MCP preflight reports the packaged versions", () => {
+  for (const [label, serverPath] of Object.entries(SERVERS)) {
+    it(`the ${label} server reports plugin 2.9.0 and OMP 18.0.11`, async () => {
+      const versions = await preflightVersions(serverPath);
+      assert.equal(versions.plugin, "2.9.0");
+      assert.equal(versions.omp, "18.0.11");
+    });
+  }
+});
+
+describe("plugin-root placeholder substitution", () => {
+  it("inserts the root verbatim, including $ replacement patterns, and recurses into arrays and objects", () => {

+  });

+describe("target config lookup", () => {

+    const configs = { "claude-plugins:omp-spec-kit": {} };

+    assert.equal(targetConfigName(configs, { "claude-plugins:omp-spec-kit": { path: "/p/.mcp.json" } }, "omp-spec-kit"), "claude-plugins:omp-spec-kit");

+});
+
+describe("bounded connect retry", () => {
+  const NAME = "claude-plugins:omp-spec-kit";
+  const targetConfigs = { [NAME]: { type: "stdio", command: "node", args: ["${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/dist/mcp/server.js"] } };
+  const targetSources = { [NAME]: { path: path.join(PLUGIN_ROOT, ".mcp.json") } };
+
+  function fakeModules(outcomes) {
+    const counters = { constructed: 0, disconnected: 0 };
+    class MCPManager {
+      constructor() {
+        counters.constructed += 1;
+        this.attempt = counters.constructed;
+      }
+      async connectServers() {
+        if (outcomes[this.attempt - 1] === "ok") return { connectedServers: [NAME], tools: [{}] };
+        return { connectedServers: [], tools: [] };
+      }
+      getTools() {
+        return [{ mcpServerName: NAME, mcpToolName: "spec_catalog" }];
+      }
+      async disconnectAll() {
+        counters.disconnected += 1;
+      }
+    }
+    return { modules: { MCPManager }, counters };
+  }
+
+  it("returns the connected tool when the third attempt succeeds", async () => {
+    const { modules, counters } = fakeModules(["fail", "fail", "ok"]);
+    const connected = await loadAndConnect(PLUGIN_ROOT, "omp-spec-kit", targetConfigs, targetSources, modules, 5_000);
+    assert.equal(connected.serverName, NAME);
+    assert.equal(connected.tool.mcpToolName, "spec_catalog");
+    assert.equal(counters.constructed, 3);
+    assert.equal(counters.disconnected, 2);
+  });
+
+  it("stops after exactly three attempts and names the bound", async () => {
+    const { modules, counters } = fakeModules(["fail", "fail", "fail"]);
+    await assert.rejects(
+      loadAndConnect(PLUGIN_ROOT, "omp-spec-kit", targetConfigs, targetSources, modules, 5_000),
+      /connect failed after 3 attempts/u,
+    );
+    assert.equal(counters.constructed, 3);
+    assert.equal(counters.disconnected, 3);
+  });
+});
+
+describe("package-root refusal", () => {
+  it("refuses a cwd equal to an absolute package root without throwing", () => {
+    const dir = realpathSync.native(mkdtempSync(path.join(tmpdir(), "omp-spec-kit-package-root-")));
+    try {

+      const context = resolveRepositoryContext({ OMP_SPEC_KIT_PACKAGE_ROOT: "." }, dir);
+      assert.notEqual(context.rootMode, "refused");
+      assert.equal(context.refused, undefined);
+    } finally {
+      rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true, maxRetries: 3 });

+
+describe("candidate file modes", () => {

+describe("release manager tool count", () => {
+  it("pins 2.9.0 to the ten-tool surface and leaves an unlisted version on the fallback", () => {
+    assert.equal(expectedManagerToolCount("2.9.0"), 10);
+    assert.equal(expectedManagerToolCount("2.9.1"), 8);
+  });
+});
+
+describe("version identity across the built payload", () => {
+  it("keeps the dist manifest, plugin manifest, plugin-version module, and build script at 2.9.0", () => {
+    const dist = JSON.parse(readFileSync(path.join(PLUGIN_ROOT, "dist", "manifest.json"), "utf8"));
+    const plugin = JSON.parse(readFileSync(path.join(PLUGIN_ROOT, ".claude-plugin", "plugin.json"), "utf8"));
+    const pluginVersionModule = readFileSync(path.join(repositoryRoot, "src", "adapters", "plugin-version.js"), "utf8");
+    const buildScript = readFileSync(path.join(repositoryRoot, "scripts", "build-plugin.mjs"), "utf8");
+    assert.equal(dist.pluginVersion, "2.9.0");
+    assert.equal(plugin.version, "2.9.0");
+    assert.match(pluginVersionModule, /export const PLUGIN_VERSION = "2\.9\.0";/u);
+    assert.match(buildScript, /const PLUGIN_VERSION = "2\.9\.0";/u);
+  });
+});

+import assert from "node:assert/strict";
+import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
+import { mkdirSync, mkdtempSync, readFileSync, realpathSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
+import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
+import path from "node:path";
+import { after, describe, it } from "node:test";
+import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
+
+// Runs the tagged-candidate extractor against throwaway git repositories whose
+// v9.9.9 tag carries one MCP declaration shape per case. Accepted shapes must
+// extract the declared entrypoint; anything else must fail with the shape guard.
+const repositoryRoot = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "..", "..");
+const EXTRACTOR = path.join(repositoryRoot, "scripts", "lifecycle", "build-tagged-candidate.mjs");
+const PLUGIN_ROOT_ENTRY = "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/dist/mcp/server.js";
+const TAGGED_SERVER = "// tagged server\n";
+const directories = [];
+
+after(() => {
+  for (const dir of directories) rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
+});
+
+function git(cwd, args) {
+  const result = spawnSync("git", args, { cwd, encoding: "utf8", windowsHide: true });
+  assert.equal(result.status, 0, `git ${args.join(" ")} failed: ${result.stderr}`);
+}
+
+function taggedRepository(server) {
+  const dir = realpathSync.native(mkdtempSync(path.join(tmpdir(), "omp-spec-kit-tagged-")));
+  directories.push(dir);
+  const pluginDir = path.join(dir, "plugins", "omp-spec-kit");
+  mkdirSync(path.join(pluginDir, "dist", "mcp"), { recursive: true });
+  writeFileSync(path.join(pluginDir, "package.json"), `${JSON.stringify({ name: "omp-spec-kit", version: "9.9.9" }, null, 2)}\n`);
+  writeFileSync(path.join(pluginDir, "dist", "mcp", "server.js"), TAGGED_SERVER);
+  writeFileSync(
+    path.join(pluginDir, "dist", "manifest.json"),
+    `${JSON.stringify({ schema: "omp-spec-kit-dist-manifest@1", pluginVersion: "9.9.9", files: { "mcp/server.js": {} } }, null, 2)}\n`,
+  );
+  writeFileSync(
+    path.join(pluginDir, ".mcp.json"),
+    `${JSON.stringify({ mcpServers: { "omp-spec-kit": { type: "stdio", ...server } } }, null, 2)}\n`,
+  );
+  git(dir, ["init", "-q"]);
+  git(dir, ["add", "-A"]);
+  git(dir, ["-c", "user.name=test", "-c", "user.email=test@example.invalid", "-c", "commit.gpgsign=false", "commit", "-q", "-m", "tagged fixture"]);
+  git(dir, ["tag", "v9.9.9"]);
+  return dir;
+}
+
+function extract(repo) {
+  const env = { ...process.env };
+  delete env.OMP_SPEC_KIT_BDD_CONTAINER;
+  for (const key of Object.keys(env)) if (key.startsWith("OMP_SPEC_KIT_TAGGED_COMMIT")) delete env[key];
+  const output = path.join(repo, "out");
+  const result = spawnSync(process.execPath, [EXTRACTOR, "--tag", "v9.9.9", "--output", output, "--repository-root", repo], {
+    encoding: "utf8",
+    env,
+    windowsHide: true,
+  });
+  return { result, output };
+}
+
+describe("tagged candidate accepts the declared MCP shapes", () => {
+  it("extracts the current ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} entrypoint", () => {
+    const { result, output } = extract(taggedRepository({ command: "node", args: [PLUGIN_ROOT_ENTRY], env: { OMP_SPEC_KIT_ROOT: "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}" } }));
+    assert.equal(result.status, 0, result.stderr);
+    assert.equal(readFileSync(path.join(output, "dist", "mcp", "server.js"), "utf8"), TAGGED_SERVER);
+    assert.equal(JSON.parse(result.stdout).schema, "omp-spec-kit-tagged-candidate-extraction@1");
+  });
+
+  it("extracts the historical node dist/mcp/server.js shape", () => {
+    const { result, output } = extract(taggedRepository({ command: "node", args: ["dist/mcp/server.js"] }));
+    assert.equal(result.status, 0, result.stderr);
+    assert.equal(readFileSync(path.join(output, "dist", "mcp", "server.js"), "utf8"), TAGGED_SERVER);
+  });
+});
+
+describe("tagged candidate rejects other MCP declaration shapes", () => {
+  it("rejects a launcher other than node", () => {
+    const { result } = extract(taggedRepository({ command: "npx", args: ["-y", "omp-spec-kit"] }));
+    assert.equal(result.status, 1);
+    assert.match(result.stderr, /unsupported command shape/u);
+  });
+
+  it("rejects a placeholder entrypoint followed by extra arguments", () => {
+    const { result } = extract(taggedRepository({ command: "node", args: [PLUGIN_ROOT_ENTRY, "--inspect"] }));
+    assert.equal(result.status, 1);
+    assert.match(result.stderr, /unsupported command shape/u);
+  });
+
+  it("rejects a placeholder entrypoint that names a file other than the tagged server", () => {
+    const { result } = extract(taggedRepository({ command: "node", args: ["${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/dist/other.js"] }));
+    assert.equal(result.status, 1);
+    assert.match(result.stderr, /unsupported command shape/u);
+  });
+});

+import assert from "node:assert/strict";

+

+  for (const entry of COPIED) {
+    const target = path.join(dir, entry);
+    mkdirSync(path.dirname(target), { recursive: true });
+    cpSync(path.join(repositoryRoot, entry), target, { recursive: true });
+  }
+  return dir;
+}
+
+function verify(dir, script) {
+  return spawnSync(process.execPath, [path.join(dir, "scripts", script)], {

+    timeout: 120_000,
+    windowsHide: true,

+  const file = path.join(dir, relative);
+  const value = JSON.parse(readFileSync(file, "utf8"));
+  mutate(value);
+  writeFileSync(file, `${JSON.stringify(value, null, 2)}\n`);
+}
+

+  assert.notEqual(result.status, 0, `verifier accepted a tampered tree; stdout=${result.stdout}`);
+  assert.match(result.stderr, message);
+}

+describe("payload verifiers accept the untouched inputs", () => {

+describe("payload verifier rejections", () => {

+    const hook = path.join(dir, "plugins", "omp-spec-kit", "hooks", "pretooluse.mjs");
+    writeFileSync(hook, readFileSync(hook, "utf8").replace('"../dist/enforcement/classifier.js"', '"../dist/enforcement/guard.js"'));
+    assertRejected(verify(dir, "verify-package.mjs"), /hooks\/pretooluse\.mjs must load \.\.\/dist\/enforcement\/classifier\.js/u);
+  });
+});
+
+describe("payload extension and hook import rejections", () => {
+  it("rejects a dist extension that is stale against src/v0.1", () => {
+    const dir = copyRepository();
+    const dist = path.join(dir, "plugins", "omp-spec-kit", "dist", "extension.js");
+    writeFileSync(dist, readFileSync(dist, "utf8").replace('export const PLUGIN_VERSION = "2.9.0";', 'export const PLUGIN_VERSION = "2.8.1";'));
+    assertRejected(verify(dir, "verify-package.mjs"), /dist\/extension\.js is stale against src\/v0\.1\/extension\.js/u);
+  });
+
+  it("rejects a source-only PLUGIN_VERSION change to src/v0.1/extension.js", () => {
+    const dir = copyRepository();
+    const source = path.join(dir, "src", "v0.1", "extension.js");
+    writeFileSync(source, readFileSync(source, "utf8").replace('export const PLUGIN_VERSION = "2.9.0";', 'export const PLUGIN_VERSION = "2.8.1";'));
+    assertRejected(verify(dir, "verify-package.mjs"), /dist\/extension\.js is stale against src\/v0\.1\/extension\.js/u);
+  });
+
+  it("rejects an extension whose SCHEMA_VERSION is not 1 in both source and dist", () => {
+    const dir = copyRepository();
+    const source = path.join(dir, "src", "v0.1", "extension.js");
+    const dist = path.join(dir, "plugins", "omp-spec-kit", "dist", "extension.js");
+    const bumped = (text) => text.replace(/SCHEMA_VERSION = "1";/u, 'SCHEMA_VERSION = "9";');
+    writeFileSync(source, bumped(readFileSync(source, "utf8")));
+    writeFileSync(dist, bumped(readFileSync(dist, "utf8")));
+    editJson(dir, path.join("plugins", "omp-spec-kit", "dist", "manifest.json"), (value) => {
+      value.files["extension.js"].sha256 = createHash("sha256").update(readFileSync(dist)).digest("hex");
+    });
+    assertRejected(verify(dir, "verify-package.mjs"), /extension\.js does not embed exported SCHEMA_VERSION 1/u);
+  });
+
+  it("rejects a hook that imports a package outside node builtins", () => {
+    const dir = copyRepository();
+    const hook = path.join(dir, "plugins", "omp-spec-kit", "hooks", "normalize.mjs");
+    writeFileSync(hook, `import zod from "zod";\n${readFileSync(hook, "utf8")}`);
+    assertRejected(verify(dir, "verify-package.mjs"), /has forbidden runtime import: zod/u);
+  });
+
+  it("rejects a hook that imports the classifier directly", () => {
+    const dir = copyRepository();
+    const hook = path.join(dir, "plugins", "omp-spec-kit", "hooks", "normalize.mjs");
+    writeFileSync(hook, `import "../dist/enforcement/classifier.js";\n${readFileSync(hook, "utf8")}`);
+    assertRejected(verify(dir, "verify-package.mjs"), /has forbidden runtime import: \.\.\/dist\/enforcement\/classifier\.js/u);
+  });
+});

 {"source":{"data":"@mcp-release-integrity\nFeature: Verify the v0.4.1 release evidence boundary\n  These scenarios are the executable projection of the release-integrity\n  scenarios in the authoring corpus. They run against the real packaged server\n  and emit the canonical scenario ids consumed by the evidence composer.\n\n  Background:\n    Given an isolated v0.3.2 package and manifest-verified corpus exist\n  @release-evidence @id:SCEN-mri-active-project-root\n  Scenario: Installed launcher uses the active project root\n    Given project-a, project-b, and package-decoy have distinct specifications\n    When the installed package launcher serves project-a without an override\n    Then the MCP overview contains only project-a specifications\n    And relative unresolved or package-root overrides cannot select package-decoy\n    When an explicit validated absolute override selects project-b\n    Then the MCP inventory contains only project-b specifications\n    And launcher startup from package cwd is refused before serving\n\n@release-evidence @id:SCEN-mri-active-project-manager-receipt\nScenario: OMP manager executes spec patch tool through packaged discovery\n  Given a disposable real authoring corpus and live MCP server\n  When the scenario \"omp-manager-authoring\" runs\n  Then the scenario passes\n\n  @release-evidence @id:SCEN-mri-terminal-json-rpc\n  Scenario: Invalid JSON-RPC requests have one terminal response\n    Given an installed MCP server is running\n    When the client sends JSON-RPC 1.0 with id 7 and then a valid request\n    Then the first response is -32600 for id 7\n    And the valid request returns one canonical envelope with no extra stdout frames\n    When the client sends an unknown method with id 8 and an unknown tool with id 9\n    Then the responses are -32601 for id 8 and -32602 for id 9\n\n  @id:SCEN-mri-malformed-json-recovery\n  Scenario: Malformed JSON has one parse error and recovery\n    Given an installed MCP server is running\n    When the client sends malformed JSON and then a valid request\n    Then the first response is -32700 with null id\n    And the valid request returns one canonical envelope with no extra stdout frames\n\n  @release-evidence @id:SCEN-mri-all-tool-parity\n  Scenario: Every historical packaged MCP handler executes\n    Given a copied package has no source checkout or ambient dependencies\n    When every SCHEMA-11 tool is called with its valid arguments\n    Then each structured result equals the direct service envelope\n    And the served corpus is byte-for-byte unchanged\n\n  @release-evidence @id:SCEN-mri-public-eligibility-separation\n  Scenario: Meta-only producer output cannot become trusted evidence\n    Given a v0.4.1 candidate and complete evidence record\n    When the current candidate message artifact contains only meta\n    Then the current candidate is refused for nonsemantic Cucumber evidence\n\n  @release-evidence @id:SCEN-mri-artifact-mismatch-refusal\n  Scenario: Publication refuses different archive bytes\n    Given the bounded v0.3.2 predecessor release status record\n    When the predecessor publication identities are reconciled\n    Then the predecessor record contains one exact published archive identity\n    Given a v0.4.1 candidate without live distribution provenance\n    When current publish verification sees a different archive identity\n    Then current publication is refused before release mutation\n\n  @release-evidence @id:SCEN-mri-public-communication-proof\n  Scenario: Public communication reflects immutable v0.3.2 evidence\n    Given the bounded v0.3.2 predecessor release status record\n    When the predecessor publication identities are reconciled\n    Then the predecessor record proves a trusted public release for its exact candidate\n    And predecessor public guidance retains the v0.3.0 advisory\n","uri":"tests/features/release-evidence.feature","mediaType":"text/x.cucumber.gherkin+plain"}}

+import assert from "node:assert/strict";
+import { spawn } from "node:child_process";
+import { mkdir, mkdtemp, rm, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";
+import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
+import path from "node:path";
+import { createInterface } from "node:readline";
+import { after, before, describe, test } from "node:test";
+import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
+
+// Spawns the real source entry point (src/mcp/server.js), so no build is
+// needed. The working directory is always a throwaway temp project.
+const SERVER_PATH = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "..", "src", "mcp", "server.js");
+const REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS = 15000;
+const LATEST = "2025-11-25";
+
+function startServer({ cwd, packageRoot }) {
+  const env = { ...process.env };
+  delete env.OMP_SPEC_KIT_ROOT;
+  delete env.OMP_SPEC_KIT_PACKAGE_ROOT;
+  if (packageRoot !== undefined) env.OMP_SPEC_KIT_PACKAGE_ROOT = packageRoot;
+  const child = spawn(process.execPath, [SERVER_PATH], { cwd, env, stdio: ["pipe", "pipe", "pipe"], windowsHide: true });
+  const exited = new Promise((resolve) => {
+    child.once("exit", (code, signal) => resolve({ code, signal }));
+    child.once("error", (error) => resolve({ error }));
+  });
+  let stderrText = "";
+  child.stderr.on("data", (chunk) => {
+    stderrText += chunk.toString("utf8");
+  });
+
+  const pending = new Map();
+  const reader = createInterface({ input: child.stdout });
+  reader.on("line", (line) => {
+    if (line.trim().length === 0) return;
+    const frame = JSON.parse(line);
+    const entry = pending.get(frame.id);
+    if (entry === undefined) return;
+    pending.delete(frame.id);
+    clearTimeout(entry.timer);
+    entry.resolve(frame);
+  });
+
+  let nextId = 0;
+  function request(method, params) {
+    const id = ++nextId;
+    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
+        pending.delete(id);
+        reject(new Error(`${method} timed out; server stderr:\n${stderrText}`));
+      }, REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS);
+      pending.set(id, { resolve, timer });
+      const frame = params === undefined ? { jsonrpc: "2.0", id, method } : { jsonrpc: "2.0", id, method, params };
+      child.stdin.write(`${JSON.stringify(frame)}\n`);
+    });
+  }
+
+  async function close() {
+    reader.close();
+    child.stdin.end();
+    const settled = await Promise.race([exited, new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(() => resolve(null), 5000))]);
+    if (settled === null) {
+      child.kill("SIGKILL");
+      await exited;
+    }
+  }
+
+  return { child, request, close, stderr: () => stderrText };
+}
+
+const CLIENT_INFO = { name: "mcp-protocol-test", version: "1" };
+
+function initialize(server, protocolVersion) {
+  const params = { capabilities: {}, clientInfo: CLIENT_INFO };
+  if (protocolVersion !== undefined) params.protocolVersion = protocolVersion;
+  return server.request("initialize", params);
+}
+
+describe("MCP protocol negotiation", () => {
+  let projectDir;
+  let server;
+
+  before(async () => {
+    projectDir = await mkdtemp(path.join(tmpdir(), "omp-spec-kit-protocol-"));
+    server = startServer({ cwd: projectDir });
+  });
+
+  after(async () => {
+    await server.close();
+    await rm(projectDir, { recursive: true, force: true, maxRetries: 3 });
+  });
+
+  test("echoes a supported 2025-11-25 request", async () => {
+    const response = await initialize(server, "2025-11-25");
+    assert.equal(response.result.protocolVersion, "2025-11-25");
+    assert.equal(response.result.serverInfo.name, "omp-spec-kit");
+    assert.deepEqual(response.result.capabilities, { tools: {} });
+    assert.equal(typeof response.result.instructions, "string");
+  });
+
+  test("echoes a supported 2025-06-18 request", async () => {
+    const response = await initialize(server, "2025-06-18");
+    assert.equal(response.result.protocolVersion, "2025-06-18");
+  });
+
+  test("echoes a supported 2025-03-26 request", async () => {
+    const response = await initialize(server, "2025-03-26");
+    assert.equal(response.result.protocolVersion, "2025-03-26");
+  });
+
+  test("answers an unsupported 1999-01-01 request with 2025-11-25", async () => {
+    const response = await initialize(server, "1999-01-01");
+    assert.equal(response.result.protocolVersion, LATEST);
+  });
+
+  test("answers a request without protocolVersion with the latest supported 2025-11-25", async () => {
+    const response = await initialize(server, undefined);
+    assert.equal(response.result.protocolVersion, LATEST);
+  });
+
+  test("answers a non-string protocolVersion and absent params with 2025-11-25", async () => {
+    const numeric = await server.request("initialize", { protocolVersion: 20251125, capabilities: {}, clientInfo: CLIENT_INFO });
+    assert.equal(numeric.result.protocolVersion, LATEST);
+    const bare = await server.request("initialize");
+    assert.equal(bare.result.protocolVersion, LATEST);
+  });
+
+  test("rejects server/discover immediately so clients fall back to initialize", async () => {
+    const response = await server.request("server/discover", {});
+    assert.equal(response.error.code, -32601);
+    assert.equal(response.result, undefined);
+  });
+
+  test("tools/list returns the ten tools", async () => {
+    const response = await server.request("tools/list", {});
+    const names = response.result.tools.map((tool) => tool.name);
+    assert.equal(names.length, 10);
+    assert.equal(new Set(names).size, 10);
+    assert.ok(names.includes("spec_catalog"));
+    assert.ok(names.includes("spec_patch"));
+  });
+});
+
+describe("PACKAGE_ROOT_REFUSED keeps the process alive", () => {
+  let projectDir;
+  let server;
+
+  before(async () => {
+    projectDir = await mkdtemp(path.join(tmpdir(), "omp-spec-kit-package-root-"));
+    // A corpus the server would happily serve if the refusal did not apply.
+    await mkdir(path.join(projectDir, ".specs", "decoy"), { recursive: true });
+    await writeFile(path.join(projectDir, ".specs", "decoy", "README.md"), "# Decoy\n");
+    server = startServer({ cwd: projectDir, packageRoot: projectDir });
+  });
+
+  after(async () => {
+    await server.close();
+    await rm(projectDir, { recursive: true, force: true, maxRetries: 3 });
+  });
+
+  test("initialize, ping and tools/list still answer", async () => {
+    const initialized = await initialize(server, "2025-11-25");
+    assert.equal(initialized.result.protocolVersion, "2025-11-25");
+    assert.equal(initialized.result.serverInfo.name, "omp-spec-kit");
+    const pong = await server.request("ping", {});
+    assert.deepEqual(pong.result, {});
+    const listed = await server.request("tools/list", {});
+    assert.equal(listed.result.tools.length, 10);
+  });
+
+  test("tools/call returns a PACKAGE_ROOT_REFUSED error and serves no corpus", async () => {
+    const response = await server.request("tools/call", {
+      name: "spec_catalog",
+      arguments: { view: "overview", specSlugs: ["decoy"] },
+    });
+    assert.equal(response.result, undefined);
+    assert.match(response.error?.message ?? "", /PACKAGE_ROOT_REFUSED/u);
+    assert.doesNotMatch(JSON.stringify(response), /decoy/u);
+  });

+  test("the process has not exited and initialize still answers after the refusal", async () => {
+    assert.equal(server.child.exitCode, null, `server exited early; stderr:\n${server.stderr()}`);
+    assert.equal(server.child.signalCode, null);
+    const response = await initialize(server, "2025-06-18");
+    assert.equal(response.result.protocolVersion, "2025-06-18");
+  });
+});

+  let projectDir;
+  let server;

+    await mkdir(path.join(projectDir, ".specs", "decoy"), { recursive: true });
+    await writeFile(path.join(projectDir, ".specs", "decoy", "README.md"), "# Decoy\n");
+    server = startServer({ cwd: projectDir });
+  });
+
+  after(async () => {
+    await server.close();
+    await rm(projectDir, { recursive: true, force: true, maxRetries: 3 });
+  });
+
+  test("tools/call returns a tool result, not a refusal", async () => {
+    await initialize(server, "2025-11-25");
+    const response = await server.request("tools/call", {
+      name: "spec_catalog",
+      arguments: { view: "overview", specSlugs: ["decoy"] },
+    });
+    assert.equal(response.error, undefined, JSON.stringify(response));
+    assert.equal(typeof response.result?.structuredContent, "object");
+    assert.doesNotMatch(JSON.stringify(response), /PACKAGE_ROOT_REFUSED/u);
+  });
+});
